name: Vinh Market
kicker: The market hall, and the foam coffee
summary: Come in the morning for the hall and the foam coffee. A 2025 page says cà phê bọt has been poured in Chợ Vinh for more than 30 years, black or with milk, the foam drunk first or stirred in. The photograph is the street front, not the aisle. Hours were not printed. The Cao Thắng night market in front of the hall stopped after a few months in 2019.
getThere: In the center. A door number was not printed.
heroCaption: The street front of Chợ Vinh. The hall and the aisle are not in this frame.

notice.title: The Cao Thắng night market stopped
notice.body: Tuổi Trẻ says the 2019 night market on Cao Thắng, in front of Chợ Vinh, stopped after a few months. Do not go there for a night market. The walking street is a different night.

gettingThere: The national page names Chợ Vinh among city sights. The city portal lists Chợ Vinh, Chợ Ga Vinh, and Chợ Quán Lau as the large markets. A street for the main hall was not on those sentences. Check on arrival. Minutes from the square were not printed. Chợ Ga is a different hall. It is not this photograph.

legs.heading: From the square
legs.body: In the center, on the national page and the city portal. The minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: Market hours were not printed. Check on arrival. The morning is the hour the pages use for the hall.
admissionNote: No entry fee was printed. Check on arrival. A stall price was not copied.
